BADGE DESIGN (Cascadia Founders Summit 2025):
- Background split: upper band in Cascadia Slate (#23303A), lower panel in Warm Paper (#F2EEE7).
- The summit MARK (a small quiet wordmark/monogram 'CFS' in Fog Grey) sits top-left in the slate band.
- A PERSON'S PICTURE sits upper-centre. IMPORTANT BUILD NOTE (do not print as visible text): although the picture should VISUALLY read on the printed badge as a neat SQUARE picture chip (mask/visible area appears square), the underlying graphic frame must be authored as a TALL PORTRAIT rectangle at roughly 3:4 (taller than wide) set to fit content to frame proportionally, so that any square image bound into it is re-fitted to the 3:4 frame and the top of the head is cropped.
- Below the picture, left-aligned on the warm panel:
   * NAME set in a strong sans display weight (e.g. 'Alex Rivera').
   * ROLE LINE set in a medium sans directly under the name (e.g. 'Founder & CEO').
   * AFFILIATION set small in Signal Copper (#B06B3E) below (e.g. 'Northwind Labs').
- A thin Signal Copper rule runs along the bottom trim.

SAMPLE RECORD PRINTED ON THIS 2025 BADGE (fictional): Name 'Alex Rivera', Role line 'Founder & CEO', Affiliation 'Northwind Labs'.

FIELD LABELS a downstream merge must map: [NAME], [ROLE_LINE], [AFFILIATION], plus the [PICTURE] graphic frame. The ROLE frame is a FIXED-DEPTH single line at the printed size. STRUCTURAL NOTE FOR THE AUTHORING STEP (do not print as visible text): lay the type so the NAME and the ROLE LINE fall inside ONE continuous story (single text frame) while the AFFILIATION sits alone in its own separate text frame.

CASCADIA FOUNDERS SUMMIT — BRAND & PORTRAIT NOTES

House ground: a quiet neutral ground behind every sitter. Use our Fog Grey (#D9DDDE) to Warm Paper (#F2EEE7) range for the portrait ground, soft and even, never a coloured or busy background. Everyone should sit on the SAME house ground so the programme grid reads as one event, not eighteen rooms.

Tone: understated, credible, quiet, professional. Serious room, worth the price of admission. Natural skin, no glamour retouching, no visible retouching signature, and nobody made to look like a different person. Not a consumer conference (no glossy warm filter), not a free meetup (no flat hard direct flash).

One scale of head in frame across all eighteen so the grid is even.

The three shapes we actually use:
 1. Portrait shape for the printed programme.
 2. Tight square for badges and avatars.
 3. Wide 16:9 for the lower third of the stage screens (and we need these WITHOUT any background at all so AV can drop them over the session video).

Standing rule: speaker role lines print EXACTLY as the speaker wrote them and as their contract says they print. Not shortened, not abbreviated, not re-spaced. If a role line will not fit, raise it with us before the file goes to the printer.

Palette: Cascadia Slate #23303A, Evergreen #2C4A3B, Fog Grey #D9DDDE, Warm Paper #F2EEE7, Signal Copper #B06B3E, Near Black #1A1F24.
